newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums firm, barges ease.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums firm, barges ease.

text.p: Increased demand for 10,000 tonne parcels helped underpin jet fuel cargo premiums on Monday, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures slid $3.75 to $219 a tonne, following Brent's fall on Iraqi agreement to oil-for-food terms.
A flurry of inquiries for large cargoes found little supply, keeping premiums at Dec IPE +$25/26 fob NWE -- the level of a 10,000 tonne trade on Friday -- and Dec IPE +$33/34 cif NWE.
Freight rates were firm, boosting the fob-cif spread, with demand fuelled by buying interest ahead of the British budget and Christmas.
Barges were long at Dec IPE +$27/28, around $1 softer.
